ON THE 18 th OF OCTOBER, 2023  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 43936 of 2023  BETWEEN:-
 POONAM MANDLOI W/O VICKY MANDLOI, AGED  ABOUT 26 YEARS, OCCUPATION: HOUSEWIFE VILLAGE  PALDA BHOLA PAHALWAN KA MAKAN INDORE  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (SHRI ARSHAD ALI M. HAQUE- ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION KOTWALI DISTRICT ASHOKNAGAR (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (SHRI PRAMOD PACHOURI - PUBLIC PROSECUTOR)

This application coming on for hearing this day, the c  following:
 ORDER

This first bail application has been filed by applicant under section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.143/2023 registered at Police Station Kotwali Ashoknagr district Ashoknagar (M.P.), for an offence punishable under sections 366A,
376(2)(n), 506, 370(A), 373, 120B, 34 of IPC and 5/6 of the POCSO Act.

entities.text: Police Station Kotwali Ashoknagr district Ashoknagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: As per the case of prosecution, father of the prosecutrix reported to PS Kotwali Ashoknagar on 10.03.2023 that his daughter is missing since morning.
Some unknown person has allured and taken his daughter.
PS Kotwali Ashokngar registered FIR in Crime No.143/2023 for offence punishable under section 363 of IPC.
During search, the prosecutrix was recovered on 13.05.2023 from the house of accused Mukesh at village Sirlai PS Bhikan Gaon, Distt. Khargaon.
In her statement under Sections 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C, the prosecutrix alleged that accused Dharmendra had allured her and taken to the house of Mukesh and sold her for an amount of Rs.1,20,000/-.

1 applicant Poonam accompanied victim and Dharmendra from Shankarpur to Indore.

sentences.text: Mukesh committed rape on her on the pretext of marrying with her.
She got pregnant.
She revealed to Mukesh that Dharmendra is not related to her and she left her home without informing her parents.
Thereafter, Mukesh contacted her parents.
The Police recovered her from the house of Mukesh from village Sirlai.
Accused Indar Khede had an altercation with accused Dharmendra when Dharmendra attempted to take the prosecutrix from to his home.
On such allegations, offence under Sections 366A, 376(2)(n), 506, 370(A), 373, 120B, 34 of IPC and 5/6 of the POCSO Act.
The final report has been filed on 18.07.2023.
The applicant was arrested on 17.05.2023 and she is in custody ever since.
Learned counsel for the applicant in addition to the grounds mentioned in the application, submits that applicant has falsely been implicated in the matter.
The applicant is aged 26 years.
She is a homemaker by profession.
She has a family to look after.
No criminal antecedent is reported against the applicant.
There is no likelihood of her absconding leaving behind her family.
She is not involved in the alleged offence of abduction or rape.
Only allegation against the applicant is accompanying the victim on motorcycle from Shankarpur to Indore.
She was not aware of the misdeed of Dharmendra.
Learned counsel further contends that Co-accused Bhuriya Bai has been granted bail vide order dated 1st June, 2023 passed in M.Cr.C.No.23465 of 2023.
The applicant's case is on better footing, therefore, she may also be extended the benefit of bail.
Per contra, learned counsel for the State opposes the bail application on the ground of gravity of alleged offence.
Heard learned learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
Considering the arguments advanced by both the parties and overall circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merits of the case, this Court is inclined to grant bail to the applicant.
Thus, the application is allowed.
